requirements.description: Remove the input-size check (text_input_size / text_input.tell() comparison) that the new pattern makes unnecessary.
In visible_input, read with next(text_input).rstrip("\r\n") and raise EOFError() from e on StopIteration.

label.evidence: src/click/testing.py:355-358 (the try/next(text_input)/except StopIteration → EOFError); input-size check removed from visible_input and the text_input_size setup deleted; same pattern also at :367-370 in hidden_input
label.notes: Reviewer's suggested try/next/except StopIteration → EOFError pattern is applied verbatim in visible_input (355-358), and the text_input_size setup and check are removed. The author also applied the same pattern to hidden_input and made unrelated changes (stream mixer __del__, shutil import move); none affect these requirements.
